title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
page_text_ocr_zh:
青蛙河肚的春雷
QING WA HE BU DE CHUN LEI
page_text_en:
Frogs River Belly's Spring Thunder
QING WA HE BU DE CHUN LEI
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的标题页，左侧绘有一位骑着扫帚的小女巫，右侧绿色背景上竖排写着书名《青蛙河肚的春雷》。

title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
page_text_ocr_zh:
青蛙阿肚醒了好久了。
他一直在等着春雷响。
按照往年的习惯，只要春雷一响，青蛙的冬眠就该结束了。可是今年的春雷为什么迟迟不来呢？
等着等着，青蛙阿肚又迷迷糊糊睡着了。
这时，蟾蜍胖胖来敲青蛙家的门，他说：“阿肚，该醒醒了，春雷响过了！”
“胡说！”青蛙抬起身子说，“一定是你贪玩了，想早点出门，但这是不合规矩的。”
青蛙说着，又倒下睡着了。
page_text_en:
The frog Ah Du had been awake for a long time.
He was waiting for the spring thunder to sound.
According to the habit of past years, as soon as the spring thunder sounded, the frog's hibernation should have ended. But why hasn't the spring thunder come this year?
Waiting and waiting, frog Ah Du fell back into a drowsy sleep.
At this moment, the toad Pang Pang came to knock on the frog's door. He said, "Ah Du, you should wake up now, the spring thunder has sounded!"
"Nonsense!" the frog raised his body and said, "You must be playing around and want to go out early, but that's against the rules."
The frog said this, then lay down and fell asleep again.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了青蛙阿肚在冬眠后醒来，因春雷迟迟未响而困惑，随后又睡着。蟾蜍胖胖前来敲门提醒他春雷已响，阿肚却认为对方贪玩，不合规矩，最终又睡着了。

title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
page_text_ocr_zh:
“这不好。”乌龟说，“这样会睡出病来的！”
“谁让他这样固执呢？”蟾蜍胖胖说，“应该让固执的人吃点苦头。”
这时，小刺猬和两位朋友咬咬耳朵，他们都笑了。
不一会儿，刺猬和乌龟抬来一面大鼓。
蟾蜍力气大，他使劲击了几下鼓：
“咚，咚，咚……”
page_text_en:
"This is no good," said the turtle, "you'll sleep yourself sick!"
"Who let him be so stubborn?" said Toad Puff, "He should be made to suffer a little for being stubborn."
At that moment, the little hedgehog and his two friends whispered to each other, and they all laughed.
Soon after, the hedgehog and the turtle carried a big drum over.
The toad was strong, and he struck the drum a few times:
"Boom, boom, boom..."
summary_zh: 乌龟和刺猬认为青蛙阿肚固执，应该让他吃点苦头，于是抬来一面大鼓。蟾蜍胖胖力气大，使劲敲鼓，发出“咚咚咚”的声音。

title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
page_text_ocr_zh:
“春雷响了！”青蛙阿肚冲出门来，一见朋友们，他惊呆了。
“不是春雷，是我们把你叫起来的！”乌龟说，“你太固执了！”
“我们快去找东西吃，肚子饿坏了！”伙伴们说。

这时春风吹来，河水都解冻了。
“我们出发吧！”青蛙阿肚说，“真的饿坏了！”
蟾蜍胖胖说：“应该让固执的朋友吃点苦头。”他把那面鼓交给了青蛙阿肚去背。
page_text_en:
"The spring thunder has sounded!" Frog Adu rushed out the door. Seeing his friends, he was stunned.
"It's not thunder, it's us who woke you up!" said the turtle. "You're too stubborn!"
"Let's go find something to eat quickly, I'm starving!" said the friends.

At this moment, the spring wind blew, and the river water had thawed.
"Let's go!" said Frog Adu. "I'm really starving!"
Toad Pangan said, "We should make the stubborn friend suffer a bit." He handed the big drum to Frog Adu to carry.
summary_zh: 青蛙阿肚被朋友们叫醒后，误以为是春雷，随后在朋友们的催促下准备出发。蟾蜍胖胖认为他太固执，便将之前抬来的鼓交给他去背。

title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
page_text_ocr_zh:
青蛙阿肚背起鼓跟在大伙儿后面，他一面走一面敲起鼓：“咚，咚，咚，春雷响了，没睡醒的朋友快起床，春天真的来到了……”

鸭蛋·鸡蛋·老鼠蛋
page_text_en:
Frog Adu carried the drum and followed the group. As he walked, he beat the drum: "Dong, dong, dong, the spring thunder has sounded! Friends who haven't woken up, get up quickly—the spring has truly arrived..."

Duck Egg · Chicken Egg · Mouse Egg
summary_zh: 青蛙阿肚背着鼓跟在朋友们后面，一边走一边敲鼓，喊着春雷响了、春天到了。右侧页面竖排写着“鸭蛋·鸡蛋·老鼠蛋”。
